work.title: Integrate the final manifest only during accept
work.description: When a Work is accepted, construct one squash commit containing the accepted product tree and the final canonical manifest projection, when final projections remain part of the v1 base format. The accepted commit is created directly from the current base, the verified candidate, and the final authoritative manifest.
acceptance: Accept creates exactly one new commit on the base
The commit contains the final product content
The commit contains the final canonical manifest projection when required by the compatibility contract
No earlier open-Work projection commit is required
The integration commit contains the Work trailer
Repeating integration converges on the existing integration commit
A stale or conflicting base is refused before the base moves
